findings.location: content.body.variantPolicyUk: «двох адресатів (наприклад, usted і él/ella в оповіданні)»
findings.description: A narrative él/ella identifies a third-person subject, not an alternative addressee. The policy conflates identifying an addressee with distinguishing directive and narrative readings.
findings.suggestion: Distinguish the subject of a narrative from the addressee of an instruction. Require enough context to establish a directive reading before assessing its addressee.

items.reviewerAnswer: In affirmative instructions, habla addresses tú, hablad addresses vosotros, hable addresses usted, and hablen addresses ustedes.
items.notes: The four affirmative imperative forms themselves are correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapters 16 (personal pronouns and forms of address) and 42 (modality and imperative constructions) (from memory).

findings.description: «Попросити «ти»» does not naturally or grammatically express making a request to someone addressed informally. The intended address construction is missing.
findings.suggestion: Write: «Щоб дати інструкцію чи звернутися з проханням до однієї людини на «ти», беремо форму él/ella теперішнього часу…»

items.reviewerAnswer: habla, mira, espera, llama, come, lee, escribe, abre.
items.notes: The Spanish formation rule is correct within the stated regular-verb scope.
sources: Course contract, rule 8: learner-facing Ukrainian must be correct and natural.
Словник української мови в 11 томах, entries «просити» and «попросити» (from memory).

findings.location: content.body.steps[id=s3].blocks[0].text: «знак наголосу не пишемо»; content.body.steps[id=s8].blocks[0].items[2]: «без чергування й без знака наголосу»
findings.description: The lesson states a blanket rule that vosotros imperative forms have no written accent. Bare forms such as oíd and reíd require one. The listed examples are correct, but the orthographic generalization is misleading.
findings.suggestion: Limit the statement to the forms taught here: «У наведених формах знак наголосу не потрібен: hablad, comed, escribid». Revise the summary accordingly.

items.reviewerAnswer: Regular affirmative tú forms include habla, come and escribe; the listed stem changes give cierra, vuelve and pide. Vosotros forms include hablad, comed and escribid.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), accentuation of hiatus containing stressed í/ú adjacent to an unstressed open vowel (from memory).
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, conjugation tables for «oír» and «reír»: vosotros imperatives oíd and reíd (from memory).
